Questline.Title: {=sp_ka_title}The Black Ledger & The Web of Shadows

Stage.LogText: {=sp_ka_s1_log}A dying black pigeon collapsed onto your campfire, its claws clutching a scorched parchment written in the fugitive artisan's trembling hand: '{Dost_Name} is not serving the Motherland; he is turning it into an abattoir. The Black Ledger detailing every manufactured war and staged assassination is hidden in {GizliSehir_Link}. Find the broker {KaraMuhbir_Link} before the silencers bury the truth.' Ride to {GizliSehir_Link} and locate {KaraMuhbir_Link}!

{=sp_ka_s2_log}Just as {KaraMuhbir_Link} confessed, the death squad {GolgeSuikastcilar_Link} ambushed the district to silence anyone seeking the Black Ledger! Slay the assassins to survive and secure the coordinates to the cipher vault.

{=sp_ka_inq_defeat_text}The Shadow Silencers have overwhelmed your forces and pinned you to the blood-soaked stones, a poisoned dagger pressed against your throat. Their captain sneers down at you: 'The secret council wants no witnesses... Unless your own gold can pay for our departure, your journey ends here.'

Action.Title: {=sp_ka_inq_defeat_title}At the Silencers' Mercy
Action.Text: {=sp_ka_inq_defeat_text}The Shadow Silencers have overwhelmed your forces and pinned you to the blood-soaked stones, a poisoned dagger pressed against your throat. Their captain sneers down at you: 'The secret council wants no witnesses... Unless your own gold can pay for our departure, your journey ends here.'

Stage.LogText: {=sp_ka_s2_fail_bribe_log}The Shadow Silencers overpowered your forces. You were forced to part with a tenth of your gold to purchase your survival. Left bleeding in the alleys, your hunt for the Black Ledger ended in defeat.
{=sp_ka_s2_fail_exec_log}Defiant to the end, you refused to bow or bribe your ambushers. The Shadow Silencers carried out their grim decree, executing you in the dark alleyways.
{=sp_ka_s3_log}With the assassins broken, seek out the vault keeper {KasaKorumasi_Link} in {GizliSehir_Link} to unlock the iron casket and seize the Black Ledger.

{=sp_ka_s_success_log}The Black Ledger is now in your hands, guided by the dying black pigeon of the spared artisan from Severed Ties! Its blackened pages expose {Dost_Name} and the Scavenger Pigeons as the architects behind endless border conflicts across Calradia. Armed with the realm's deadliest blackmail, you gained 60,000 denars, 60 renown, and cemented your feared standing in the shadows.

DialogNode.Text: {=sp_ka_dlg_m_intro}Keep your voice down, stranger! The street stones have ears, and silencers are lurking around every corner. Who sent you into my den?
{=sp_ka_dlg_m_entry}I am looking for the one who keeps records of the shadow trade.
{=sp_ka_dlg_m_intro}Keep your voice down, stranger! The street stones have ears, and silencers are lurking around every corner. Who sent you into my den?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p1_inq}A dying black pigeon reached me from the frontier. The fugitive artisan told me you hold the key to the Black Ledger.
{=sp_ka_dlg_p1_skep}You look terrified. Are you an honest broker of secrets, or another bait laid out by {Dost_Name}?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p1_prag}I didn't come to exchange pleasantries. Point me to the cipher archive, or I leave you to his hounds.
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_m_pigeon_reveal}So the spared artisan's black pigeon from Severed Ties reached you after all... That fugitive risked everything to expose the war machine. What do you want from an old bookkeeper like me? Knowing what is inside that ledger is a death warrant across the whole continent!
{=sp_ka_dlg_p2_why}Why a death warrant? What could be written on parchment that frightens every lord in Calradia?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p2_dost}How deeply is {Dost_Name} involved? Is he merely a rogue operative, or does the entire Scavenger Pigeon leadership answer to him?
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_m_ledger_lore}It is the ledger of manufactured wars! Over forty lords from three rival kingdoms paid {Dost_Name} to assassinate legitimate heirs, poison wells, and stage border raids. {Dost_Name} orchestrates the slaughter, and the Pigeons sell both sides the intelligence to fight! The ledger is his ultimate insurance against kings.
{=sp_ka_dlg_p3_power}Whoever controls this ledger holds the collar of every corrupt ruler in Calradia. Where is the vault?
{=sp_ka_dlg_p3_doubt}If {Dost_Name} keeps such a dangerous record here, his personal guard cannot be far behind.
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_m_ambush_panic}You're right! Curse the heavens, look past the alleyway! Shadow cloaks and drawn crossbows... An elite death squad has encircled the district! They know I've revealed the location! We are cornered!
{=sp_ka_dlg_p4_fight_heroic}Let them send their butchers. Today, the shadows bleed like mortals! (Draw Steel & Defend)
{=sp_ka_dlg_p4_fight_prag}Barricade the inner door, old man. I will turn their ambush into their graveyard. (Fight)
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
{=sp_ka_dlg_assassin_intro}Silence the witnesses! No one leaves this alley alive! For the Raven's decree!
{=sp_ka_dlg_assassin_p1}You will need more than cheap crossbows to silence me. Draw your steel! (Fight)
{=sp_ka_dlg_assassin_p2}The shadows bleed like mortals today! (Fight)
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_intro}You cut down the elite blades like wheat... I watched from the parapet. The iron casket is right here, sealed under the mark of the Raven Bone.
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_entry}The assassins outside will bother you no longer. I have come for the Black Ledger.
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_intro}You cut down the elite blades like wheat... I watched from the parapet. The iron casket is right here, sealed under the mark of the Raven Bone.
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_inq}What is the most damning truth recorded within these pages?
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_skep}How do I know this isn't another forged deception crafted to misdirect my blade?
{=sp_ka_dlg_k_prag}Enough philosophy. Crack the seals and place the casket in my custody.
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.

{=sp_ka_dlg_k_reveal}Every wax seal on these sheets bears the personal crest of {Dost_Name} and the secret council, exactly as the spared artisan warned. It proves that every skirmish, every raided caravan, and every slandered noble in the realm was orchestrated to siphon wealth into the Scavenger Pigeons' coffers. Whoever holds this holds the leash of Calradia's rulers.
{=sp_ka_dlg_fin_ruler}With this ledger, {Dost_Name}'s puppet empire is finished. From now on, the shadows answer to me. (Claim the Black Ledger)
{=sp_ka_dlg_fin_prag}Power and gold always follow the truth. I will keep this weapon close. (Claim the Black Ledger)
{=sp_ka_ertele}I cannot deal with this right now. We will speak later.
